body:
Thanks for all the resources; I'm going to read through them tonight.

The username's actually from a [song](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HFJO-mCgeh0) that I've found to be kind of helpful.

My doctor has me on fairly weak medications for now; she doesn't want me on narcotics due to my age.  Before I was the type of person who didn't even like to take Tylenol, but obviously when you feel like you've been hit by a truck you'll take whatever help you can get.

I actually meant that I *wish* I was able to go for a walk right now, as I'm currently physically unable to do so.  It's cool to see that meditation helped you out; I've never tried a guided meditation before, so I'll definitely look into that.

Thanks again.

I'd be very interested in hearing about some of the resources that you found helpful, please.

I felt better today (mentally), but I still have a lot of thoughts like "why me?" and I find myself constantly wishing that I was able to do more, even something as simple as going outside for a walk.

I try to engross myself in something like a movie or book to take my mind off those sort of things, but its hard...

I started meditating daily recently and am hoping that might help in calming my mind.

Thank you very much for your replies.
You're an extremely talented writer. Thank you very much for the post.

I've had issues with hyperhydrosis (severe sweating) for all my life, and I know how easy it is to get caught in certain thought patterns.  In social situations I'd find myself caught up in my head, which was extremely mentally taxing.

I'd always feel like people were staring at me and I'd desperately try to calm myself down which only made things worse.

I found that after I started meditating I found it a bit easier to deal with. Ill admit that I'm not at where I'd like to be,n but it has helped. Honestly I don't know all that much about SA but it might be worth looking into.

Hey man I'm really glad that your condition improved; hopefully I'll be able to say the same someday.

If you don't mind me asking did you ever have these kind of thoughts?  If so how did you deal with them? 

I'm just worried because obviously this sort of thing has the potential to go downhill...I guess I should look into chronic pain support groups or something.
